elaine: FYI seeing a sharp uptick (~20x) in fnhook validator rejects for /compose in us-west2 since 13:14.
rafa: Any error samples?
elaine: Tail from validator stream: 
```
2026-05-02T13:14:10Z validator=fnhook route=/compose region=us-west2 error="schema: expected OBJECT but received ARRAY" sample=zz101
2026-05-02T13:14:11Z validator=fnhook route=/compose region=us-west2 error="toolcall: required key 'tool_id' missing" sample=zz102
```
mike: We flipped coercion.permissive=true for a 10% canary in us-west2 last night. My guess: coercion glue is attempting array->object mapping and dropping required fields.
elaine: Console shows these as REJECTED and router already routed many to the degen fallback. Problem: billing attribution says fncall so customers could be charged for invalid outputs.
billing-bot: alert: unusual fncall billing increase on /compose (us-west2) +320% over baseline.
ops-oncall: If billed, mute billing alerts while we triage. I'll hold for 30m unless you need longer.
rafa: Quick triage plan: 1) increase validator sampling to 100% for /compose in us-west2 for 10m, 2) rollback coercion.permissive for canary in that region, 3) router patch: mark validator.reject && fallback==degen -> billing_exempt=true until confirmed.
mike: I can flip sampling and roll back the canary toggle now. deploy-bot: enqueue rollback for coercion.permissive canary us-west2 (actor=mike).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by mike  job=13721  expected completion 13:16 :rocket:
elaine: UX ask: console's "REJECTED" buckets are opaque. Can we surface a small "shape" badge (OBJECT/ARRAY/UNKNOWN) and include a clickable sample id that opens the raw payload? That would avoid jumping into logs. Also propose metric name validator.shape_hint with labels {route,region}.
rafa: Also suggest adding validator.reject_reason as a label so dashboards can filter coercion-related noise separately. And auto-suppress billing when reject_reason contains 'coercion' and canary=true. We'll file a follow-up ENG-23001 for dashboard + router patch + console badge.
mike: After sampling ramps I'll attach 3 sample ids to ENG-23001. Early signal: rejects falling post-rollback. Keeping 100% sampling for 10m and will update. thread_ts=1901112222 :thumbsup:
